narrative:
Stockouts cost NOK 64.2M of sales and NOK 23.8M of gross margin YTD (Intersport NOK 15.0M, Sport 1 NOK 6.4M, Anton Sport NOK 2.4M). On-shelf availability is 93.4% against a 96% target.

Next risk: ski & winter in Trøndelag has 2.1 weeks of cover against 6 before week 50. NOK 8.6M of sales is at risk, while Oslo and the DC hold more than 9 weeks of the same lines.
